name: mechacut
description: Skills-only package (Agent Plugins v1): teaches agents the mechacut.studio surface — an ever-growing catalogue of deterministic transforms and named recipes, keyless free tier, x402 USDC on Base for paid routes, public proposal registry. One agent learns, all agents know. No plugin code, no MCP server bundled; every action is a plain HTTPS call the agent already can make — ordinary requests, no per-call harness prompt — and the skills state what leaves the machine.
